svg.aria-label: Two reads at join 1 against the paternal scaffold there, and against where each aligns on HPRC's assembly
svg.text: a A father's read through A's end

rect.title: HPRC's paternal scaffold around join 1: A's last 15 kb (the father's, to chr2:47,340,307), 100 N, B's first 15 kb (the mother's, from chr2:46,971,835) the read's bases 1-11,310 lie here

line.title: gap 1 (100 N) below it A's last 15 kb (the father's, to chr2:47,340,307); above it B's first 15 kb (the mother's, from chr2:46,971,835)

svg.text: gap 1 (100 N) below it A's last 15 kb (the father's, to chr2:47,340,307); above it B's first 15 kb (the mother's, from chr2:46,971,835)gap 1 (100 N)

rect.title: where the read aligns on HPRC's assembly: the paternal scaffold, piece C (MAPQ 13) the read's bases 1-22,137 lie here, on one diagonal

svg.text: b A mother's read through B's start

rect.title: HPRC's paternal scaffold around join 1: A's last 15 kb (the father's, to chr2:47,340,307), 100 N, B's first 15 kb (the mother's, from chr2:46,971,835) the read's bases 12,607-25,697 lie here

line.title: gap 1 (100 N) below it A's last 15 kb (the father's, to chr2:47,340,307); above it B's first 15 kb (the mother's, from chr2:46,971,835)

svg.text: gap 1 (100 N) below it A's last 15 kb (the father's, to chr2:47,340,307); above it B's first 15 kb (the mother's, from chr2:46,971,835)gap 1 (100 N)

rect.title: where the read aligns on HPRC's assembly: the maternal chromosome, piece M (MAPQ 60) the read's bases 1-25,697 lie here, on one diagonal

svg.text: y: HPRC's paternal chromosome around join 1 (bottom window) and the stretch where the read aligns (top window), contig Mb.
Neither read crosses the gap: the father's leaves A for the sequence C holds, the mother's comes into B from M's.
Each segment: a run of exact 16-base matches, 40 bp or longer; the scattered short ones are repeats.
